guard: a connector tool advertised under the spawn capability has the exact manager.status request grant and reaches the real typed handler
command: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && corepack pnpm smoke:ep-grants
why: Describe is baseline authority, so a spawn credential can discover manager.status even when
the broker will deny the invocation itself. A stubbed MeshAgent cannot expose that mismatch.
The first mutation runs a real JWT broker, Manager, and MeshAgent with only capabilities:[spawn]
and requires the typed status reply. The second independently pins the exact grant set, including
that status does not widen into the rest of manager.read.

mutations.name: spawn credential loses the exact manager.status readiness row
mutations.find: export const SPAWN_SERVICE_COMMANDS = Object.freeze(["status", "define-persona", "inspect"] as const);
mutations.replace: export const SPAWN_SERVICE_COMMANDS = Object.freeze(["define-persona", "inspect"] as const);
mutations.command: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && PATH=/workspace/state/tools/nats-server-v2.12.12-b:$PATH corepack pnpm smoke:manager-service-invoke
mutations.expectRed: spawn-capability connector reaches the real typed manager.status handler without an override
mutations.completionMarker: invoking a command not in the resolved surface is not-found
mutations.cell: spawn-capability connector reaches the real typed manager.status handler without an override
